prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical polished lifestyle editorial portrait of an adult blonde woman relaxing on a large cream picnic blanket in a sunny park. She wears a flowy pastel-blue midi summer dress with delicate gold jewelry, rests on one elbow, and smiles warmly toward the camera. Surround her with manicured green grass, mature leafy trees, a distant lake, and a blue sky with wispy clouds. Arrange a warm-brown wicker picnic basket, a soft yellow cushion, a wooden charcuterie board with grapes, berries, orange cheddar, and crackers, plus a black tray of sushi with wooden chopsticks. Use bright late-afternoon sunlight, soft shadows, natural vibrant color, shallow depth of field, crisp food detail, and an approachable summer mood. No text, logo, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, child, sexualized pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, text, logo, watermark
